reasoning.step1:
1) Determine if document is an invoice
- Contains headings "Rechnung", "Rechnungsdatum", invoice number, line items, totals and VAT lines. No exclusion terms ("Mahnung", "Zahlungserinnerung", "Servicebericht") prominent. Conclusion: classify as invoice.

2) Locate invoice date
- Found "Rechnungsdatum 24.10.23" on page 1. Extract Invoice.Date = "24.10.23".

3) Locate sender VAT ID
- Found "USt-IdNr. ATU16406805" / "MWST Nr. ATU16406805". Extract Sender.VatId = "ATU16406805".

4) Locate totals and VAT group(s)
- On page 2: "Total EUR ohne MwSt. 11’313.46" and a VAT breakdown line: "Steuersatz 20.00 11’313.46 2’262.69" and "Total EUR inkl. MwSt. 13’576.15".
- Determine GrandTotal.Amount = 13’576.15 -> numeric 13576.15.
- Net.Amount = 11’313.46 -> numeric 11313.46.
- Vat.Amount = 2’262.69 -> numeric 2262.69.
- Vat.Rate = 20.00 per the Steuersatz; per rule remove percent symbol and keep decimals as in input => numeric 20 (no percent). (Input shows "20.00" but VAT rule asks percentage without symbol; using 20 is consistent.)

5) Verify no inference or additional exchange rates
- All extracted values are directly present. No missing required fields remain. No exchange rates to extract.

6) Final mapping (types)
- GrandTotal.Amount: number 13576.15
- Invoice.Date: string "24.10.23"
- Sender.VatId: string "ATU16406805"
- Vat.Rate: number 20
- Net.Amount: number 11313.46
- Vat.Amount: number 2262.69
